title.en: Keep Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm as printed while Plot only supplies the map
title.zh: Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm照印，曲线只当路线图

description.en: The Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm note follows the outline of Plot. Electric 15 Concrete Pump is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100–125 mm. The dash is part of the printed cell. Wall thickness and service life are not printed.
description.zh: Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm这篇笔记顺着《曲线》的大纲写。电动15型混凝土泵是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。输送管一格是 100–125 mm。连接号属于印出的原文。壁厚和寿命没有印出。

h1.en: Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm: sections borrowed from Plot
h1.zh: Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm：章节借自《曲线》

directAnswer.en: For Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Plot. Plot only lends its headings. Electric 15 Concrete Pump is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100–125 mm. The dash is part of the printed cell. Wall thickness and service life are not printed.
directAnswer.zh: 写Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《曲线》借数字。《曲线》只出借标题。 电动15型混凝土泵是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。输送管一格是 100–125 mm。连接号属于印出的原文。壁厚和寿命没有印出。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Plot”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. The sheet prints model Electric 15, motor 15 kW, output 8–10 m³/h, vertical height 15–20 m, horizontal distance 60–80 m, maximum aggregate 1–3 cm, delivery pipe inner diameter 100–125 mm, size 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm, weight 450 kg. Outlet pressure is not on this specification list. Horizontal 60–80 m is distance, not a spare-pipe length. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页在“曲线”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 参数表印出型号 Electric 15、电机 15 kW、输送量 8–10 m³/h、垂直高度 15–20 m、水平距离 60–80 m、最大骨料 1–3 cm、输送管内径 100–125 mm、外形 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、重量 450 kg。这张表没有出口压力。水平 60–80 m 是距离，不是直管长度。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Voice cast”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Order the spare from the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe page. That page is a red straight pipe with reinforced coupling ends. It has no fixed diameter table and no wall thickness. Do not rewrite 100–125 mm as the slash form 100 / 125 mm used on Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60. Electric 20 is 80 mm. Electric 10 Series is a different page and has no pipe-diameter cell. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Voice cast”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 直管从混凝土泵输送管页询价。那一页是带加强快接端的红色直管，没有固定管径表，也没有壁厚。不要把 100–125 mm 改写成搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 使用的斜线形式 100 / 125 mm。电动20是 80 mm。电动10系列是另一页，没有管径格。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Production” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send this model name, the inner diameter printed on its own page, the length you need, and the quantity. Do not send a wall thickness. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “生产”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上这一型号、它自己页面上的内径、需要的长度和数量。不要填写壁厚。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Read “Release” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. Electric 15 Concrete Pump is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100–125 mm. The dash is part of the printed cell. Wall thickness and service life are not printed. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 把“来源章节：Release”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 电动15型混凝土泵是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。输送管一格是 100–125 mm。连接号属于印出的原文。壁厚和寿命没有印出。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Reception”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Reception”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Music”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Music”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Use “Video games” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Video games”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Read “Legacy” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. question.en: Can the outline heading “Music” rename Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Music”可以改掉Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm的名称吗？

answer.en: No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “Video games” on Plot fill a blank on the Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm row?
question.zh: 《曲线》上的“来源章节：Video games”会填上Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm的空白格子吗？

answer.en: No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Why is Plot not a source of extra ratings for Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm?
question.zh: 为什么《曲线》不能给Electric 15 delivery pipe 100–125 mm增加额定值？

answer.en: Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
